# AraGrow

> Fractional CTO services for businesses between $5M and $10M in revenue — hands-on technology leadership without the full-time overhead.

AraGrow is run by David Aragó, based in Minneapolis with bilingual fluency in English and Spanish. David works directly with clients: no account managers, no handoffs. Services include a 30-day technology audit and ongoing fractional CTO engagements, most running $1,500 to $3,000 a month.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://aragrow.me/): Overview of AraGrow's fractional CTO services
- [How I Work](https://aragrow.me/how-i-work/): Engagement model, working principles, and pricing
- [Services](https://aragrow.me/services/): Fixed-price reviews for one specific problem, with prices
- [30-Day Technology Audit](https://aragrow.me/30-day-audit/): What the audit covers, deliverables, and pricing (up to $3,000)
- [Self-Assessment](https://aragrow.me/self-assessment/): Free technology self-assessment tool for business owners
- [FAQ](https://aragrow.me/faq/): Answers to common questions about services, rates, and fit
- [Blog](https://aragrow.me/blog/): Articles on AI, technology strategy, and software engineering
- [Contact](https://aragrow.me/contact/): Book a 30-minute conversation
